business.name: Courtyard by Marriott New Orleans Downtown/Convention Center

ranking.name: Courtyard by Marriott New Orleans Downtown/Convention Center

text.text_excerpt: This hotel certainly met every expectation I had and I very much enjoyed my stay here. I recently stayed here for four nights during my recent trip to New Orleans. One of the first things I noticed was that unless you know where the hotel is, it's likely you'll drive right by it and not even notice. The entrance is right inside of the parking garage, which is strange. The outside, of course, does have a sign, but it's very, very easy to miss. Front desk staff were very, very nice. No complaints there. The room was quite lovely. There was lots of room for myself and two friends. The rooms were also very clean. There was a large flat screen TV, refrigerator, and spacious closet. It's a nice hotel, cute with free wi-fi and helpful staff. Big rooms, plenty of outlets (yes, that's important) and I like that the sink is not in the same room as the shower. It's 2 trolley stops from the French Quarter. I prefer the Courtyard to the regular Marriott in the French quarter for the basic amenities (fridge in room, free wi-fi, plenty of outlets) but this location is not ideal if your doing the French Quarter. Great location for the convention center.

My favorite spot to stay at, when we come down here. Majority of things are in walking distance, so that helps to cut down on driving. Can't say enough about the professionalism the comes from the staff here. Rooms are kept very clean, you have the convenience of the bistro, which comes in handy at times. The only drawback is trying to find a place to park on the street, if you don't want to pay to park on site. Almost forgot, there is a club, so you might not want to be on that side. Can get a lil noisy, but nothing that bad... And they have a good fitness center, which is always a plus....
